# wude / wude — Forward Deployed Engineer

> wude帮助团队识别值得投入的 AI 场景，完成可用原型、系统集成、生产上线与持续优化。

Canonical website: https://cs-wude.github.io/product/
English overview: https://cs-wude.github.io/product/en/
Contact: https://cs-wude.github.io/product/#contact
GitHub profile: https://github.com/CS-wude

## Services

- AI 场景诊断与路线设计
- 可用原型与价值验证
- 系统集成与生产上线
- 运行优化与团队交接

## FDE Learning Guide

- Public Chinese guide: https://cs-wude.github.io/fde-learning/
- Repository and templates: https://github.com/CS-wude/CS-wude.github.io/tree/main/sites/fde-learning
- Audience: developers with programming fundamentals and no prior FDE experience
- Standard path: 20–28 weeks, six capability dimensions, three progressive projects
- The guide does not guarantee employment; current target-role requirements remain authoritative
